name: fast-publicodes
description: A drop-in replacement for publicodes, with the engine written in Rust.

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --esm --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.js --dts index.d.ts
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check && biome check && tsc --noEmit
